series_short_description: A gripping sci-fi thriller of corporate espionage, underground hacking, and the mysterious Crimson Node.
series_description: Dive into the dark, pulsating heart of the digital underground with Crimson Node. This gripping narrative explores the dangerous world of corporate espionage, high-stakes hacking, and the terrifying implications of a mysterious project known only as the Crimson Node. It's a thrilling ride through a world where data is the ultimate weapon.
